and can we do it in a way that doesn't get everyone at each others throats?

And that's why.

The only way to "make sure" that people don't abuse their positions is for someone else to have even more power than they have, so they can be forced to abide by some particular set of standards, and all that does is move the problem one step further up the chain. If anything, it makes it worse, or at least more dangerous, since any authority that can "make sure" that mods do this or don't do that necessarily has power over the entire site rather than just individual subs, so can abuse the entire site rather than just individual subs.

And barring that sort of authority, most attempts to "make sure" that people don't abuse their positions inevitably end up with everyone at each other's throats, since it's still an attempt to exercise authority, but without the actual authority to back it up, so it devolves into aggression and manipulation.

Just go where you want and post what you want when you want. If you run into a problem, deal with it then, however you prefer. If you don't run into a problem (and the odds are that you won't) then that's pretty much that.
